inspected_frames.observation: One fused asymmetrical fan-sector with dichotomous veins and cross-net, no separate pinnae.
Plain reverse leaf surface is solid; front-only relief deliberately not mirrored as invented fossil detail.
Paired undulating scallop edge and branching net readable. Sector is not a complete frond.
Thin closed thickness and shallow fold visible; not a single alpha plane.
Continuous rear surface with scalloped margin and no central split.
Thin solid lamina relief visible, naturally edge-on at this view.
Real raised net geometry visible without brown material; no mapped texture.
Continuous sector silhouette with rounded polygonal teeth, no deep ginkgo-like central split.

known_limitations: Illustrative scale and reconstruction; not measured site or specimen.

Sphenophyllum and Psaronius whole habits are hypotheses; Psaronius is genus-level. Hausmannia and Dictyophyllum are isolated fossil organs, not whole plants. Counts, color and scale are illustrative; no reproductive microanatomy claim.
CPU stills and Node parse are not hardware GPU or composed-scene evidence.
